extraction_notes: Main-text catalytic-performance data in figures are in Figure 1c, 1e, and 1f. Figure 1d reports apparent activation energies, not requested conversion/selectivity/STY data, and was not extracted. Figures 2 and 3 are spectroscopic/TPSR/DFT/characterisation rather than CO2-hydrogenation performance and were skipped. Figure 4a shows uncalibrated online MS methanol signal during transient feed switching, not conversion, selectivity, or calibrated STY/formation rate; it was therefore not entered in the quantitative performance fields. For Figure 1e/f, individual varied-space-velocity values are not printed in the main text; points were combined across panels by catalyst colour and CH3OH selectivity/marker order.
